description: This source file implements the SPDY protocol framing logic, including serialization of various SPDY frame types such as HEADERS, PUSH_PROMISE, SETTINGS, PING, and others. It contains methods for encoding frames, managing header compression, and handling frame-specific flags and sizes.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for serializing SPDY frames, handling frame encoding and continuation frames.

classes.name: SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator specifically for header frames, manages header encoding and continuation.

classes.name: SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for push promise frames, manages encoding and continuation.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Generic iterator for control frames, serializes a single frame.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation for serializing different SPDY frame IRs into frames.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitorWithOutput
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation for serializing frames directly into a provided output buffer.

classes.name: FlagsSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor for extracting flags from frame IRs for serialization.

methods.name: PackStreamDependencyValues
methods.description: Pack parent stream ID and exclusive flag into HTTP/2 format.

methods.name: SerializeHeaderFrameFlags
methods.description: Serialize flags for HEADERS frame based on IR properties.

methods.name: SerializePushPromiseFrameFlags
methods.description: Serialize flags for PUSH_PROMISE frame based on IR properties.

methods.name: SerializeHeadersGivenEncoding
methods.description: Serialize HEADERS frame with given header block encoding.

methods.name: SerializePushPromiseGivenEncoding
methods.description: Serialize PUSH_PROMISE frame with given header block encoding.

methods.name: WritePayloadWithContinuation
methods.description: Write header block and handle continuation frames if needed.

methods.name: SerializeDataBuilderHelper
methods.description: Compute flags and size for DATA frame with padding.

methods.name: SerializeDataFrameHeaderWithPaddingLengthFieldBuilderHelper
methods.description: Compute size and flags for DATA frame with padding length field.

methods.name: SerializeSettingsBuilderHelper
methods.description: Compute flags and size for SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: SerializeAltSvcBuilderHelper
methods.description: Compute size and serialize ALTSVC header value.
